name: siso-digital
description: SISO Digital - arquitectura de microfrontends con Module Federation sobre el patron Flux

scripts.dev: npm run build:remotos && npm run servir
scripts.servir: concurrently -n turno,ats,permiso,shell -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm run preview -w @siso/mf-turno" "npm run preview -w @siso/mf-ats" "npm run preview -w @siso/mf-permiso" "npm run dev -w @siso/shell"
